justification: Assessment reported INVALID and targeted the same defect as ground truth: the inference at lines 0011-0013 that the (malformed, inverted c/|z^{-1}|=c|z|) magnitude bound on the error term implies its derivative is O(z^{-1}). Ground truth flaw is exactly this implication. The assessment's witness h(x)=sin(e^x)/x on x>1 is a different-but-valid counterexample to the same claim: |h|<=1/x yet h'(ln(2 pi k))=2 pi k/ln(2 pi k) is unbounded, so a pointwise size bound never controls the derivative. Verified: sin(e^{x_k})=0, cos=1 at e^{x_k}=2 pi k, giving h'(x_k)=2 pi k/ln(2 pi k). Same flaw as ground truth, matching.
